plan.title: Condition x Time interaction DE + pathway analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the treatment effect differ between t0 and t1 — is an interaction question in a 2x2 (condition x time) design with 3 replicates per cell (12 samples total, single batch, raw Salmon gene counts, 12000 genes). This calls for a DESeq2 model with design ~condition*time, testing the condition:time interaction coefficient as the primary answer to 'does the effect differ by time', with the simple effects (condition effect within t0, condition effect within t1) reported alongside so a null interaction result is not over-read as 'no effect anywhere'. Track 1 runs QC (blind vst, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) to confirm the 4 groups separate as expected and no sample is a batch/identity outlier, then the DESeq2 fit, ashr shrinkage (contrasts, not single coefficients, so ashr rather than apeglm), BH-adjusted testing with independent filtering. Track 2 takes the tested-gene universe and the per-contrast significant gene lists into an over-representation analysis against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome gene sets (both staged for human) — the knowledge-service check flagged the originally planned preranked fgsea method as not permitted for this exact situation profile and named ORA-with-explicit-universe as the sanctioned alternative, so ORA is used instead, with the caveat that a short significant list (fewer than ~50 genes, plausible given only n=3/cell) gives ORA reduced power. Track 3 assembles the final report: QA diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot, p-value histograms), the three-column interaction/simple-effect table with named reference levels, the explicit power caveat for n=3 replicates and for the interaction term specifically, and the enrichment results with their caveats. No batch correction is needed (single batch reported). No translational/PK/safety scope was requested, so none is added.
